subject: Interop gateway: request for feature-flag retrofit + compatibility timeline
messages:
From: Samir Patel <samir@fluxgrid.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-09-13T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: New Gateway SDK v3: impact on FluxGrid adaptor

Hi Vanessa,

Quick note from our integration team: the SDK v3 change that removes the legacy handshake (the sidecar auth token exchange) has caused our adaptor to fail during automated validation. We relied on that handshake for session resumption and a small legacy header that your runtime emitted; without it several older enterprise customers (on-prem FluxGrid bundles) see connection errors.

We attached a short diff (api-change-diff.pdf) and a repro bundle (fluxgrid-repro.tar.gz) that demonstrates the failure on our side. Two asks from us:

- Can Redwood provide a short-term compatibility shim or server-side feature flag we can opt into while we finish migrating the adaptor?
- Can we align on a deprecation timeline and an allowance for a partner semver exemption so we have time to ship the adapter update to our customers?

This is blocking a handful of active deals (see deal FG-2028-07-1021) and we want to avoid forcing customers to do a manual rollback. Happy to jump on a call.

Thanks,
Samir
Samir Patel
Head of Integrations, FluxGrid
samir@fluxgrid.com
+1 415-555-0142

From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa@redwood.com>
To: Samir Patel <samir@fluxgrid.com>
Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-09-13T11:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: New Gateway SDK v3: impact on FluxGrid adaptor

Samir — thanks for the clear repro and the diff. I pulled Jonas and Marcus into the thread because this touches runtime behavior and partner/alliances prioritization.

High-level response and next steps:

- We can scope a short-term server-side feature-flag that re-enables the legacy handshake behavior for partner opt-in. That would be scoped as a temporary compatibility path (not intended as a permanent API surface).
- We need a minimal mutual action plan (MAP) with milestones: 1) partner repro + logs, 2) Redwood opt-in flag rollout + smoke, 3) partner adaptor patch release, 4) deprecation notice and final removal window.
- Can you confirm the set of customers impacted (list of account ids) and an ideal target date for the adaptor release?

Proposed meeting times: tomorrow 9:00–10:00 PT or 1:00–2:00 PT. I scheduled a 30m slot tentatively for 2028-09-14 09:30 PT on the HubSpot link below; please accept or propose another time.

I'll ask Jonas to propose the technical approach and Marcus to coordinate the MAP and deal-level concessions (credits/SLA).

Best,
Vanessa Ortiz
Director, Partnerships — Redwood Inference
vanessa@redwood.com
(650) 555-0199

---
Attachments referenced: api-change-diff.pdf, fluxgrid-repro.tar.gz

From: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>
To: Samir Patel <samir@fluxgrid.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa@redwood.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-09-13T12:18:00-07:00
Subject: Re: New Gateway SDK v3: impact on FluxGrid adaptor

Samir — quick technical note from runtime:

We can implement a scoped server-side toggle named 'legacy_handshake_compat' that will:
- accept the old header set and perform the previous token exchange flow
- route partner traffic to a compatibility code path with a slightly higher CPU baseline (we'll quantify)

What we need from you to fast-track:
1) a minimal reproducible request/response pair (we have the repro bundle but please include a matching request trace),
2) a short list of concrete header keys you expect preserved,
3) a short smoke test we can run after the flag is enabled.

If we get those by EOD today we can push a flag to our staging cluster tomorrow and run a smoke pass with you Wednesday morning PT. Note the flag is intended to live for a limited window (we typically do 90 days for partner compatibility). If you need a longer window, we can discuss a phased deprecation.

-Jonas
Jonas Weber
Senior Staff Engineer, Runtime
jonas_weber@redwood.com

From: Samir Patel <samir@fluxgrid.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-09-13T16:42:00-07:00
Subject: Re: New Gateway SDK v3: impact on FluxGrid adaptor

Thanks Jonas — that's exactly the shape we were hoping for. Per your asks:

- Request trace + minimal repro are attached (fluxgrid-repro.tar.gz). The key headers are X-FG-Session, X-FG-Legacy-Nonce, and the prior Authorization: FG-SID token.
- Smoke test: we can run an end-to-end validation that hits the on-prem bundle for 3 customers and confirm session resumption under the toggle.
- Impacted customers (account ids): FG-ENT-001, FG-ENT-009, FG-ENT-014 — these are on older bundles and on multi-region deployments.

On timeline: we can ship an adaptor patch in ~3 weeks if we can have the flag in staging tomorrow and a short production opt-in window (we'd prefer 60–90 days). Regarding credits/SLA concessions: can Marcus share what's reasonable for deals that are blocked by this?

Samir
Samir Patel
Head of Integrations, FluxGrid

From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa@redwood.com>
To: Samir Patel <samir@fluxgrid.com>
Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-09-14T14:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: New Gateway SDK v3: impact on FluxGrid adaptor

Samir — thanks for the repro and the impacted account list. Summary of agreed next steps (following today's sync):

1) Redwood will enable 'legacy_handshake_compat' in staging by 2028-09-14 18:00 PT and run smoke tests with FluxGrid on 2028-09-15 09:00 PT. (owner: Jonas)
2) FluxGrid to deliver adaptor patch smoke artifacts by 2028-10-05. (owner: Samir)
3) Redwood will provide a partner semver exemption window of 90 days from the date we enable the production opt-in. If you need 120 days, Marcus will evaluate on a per-deal basis. (owner: Marcus)
4) Marcus to propose a deal-level concession note (one-time credit / extended rollback support) by 2028-09-16. (owner: Marcus)

HubSpot MAP: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/12345/deal/FG-2028-07-1021
Shared MAP doc (draft): https://redwood.box.com/s/abcdef123456

I've attached a draft MAP (mutual-action-plan.xlsx) and the change diff you sent remains attached (api-change-diff.pdf). Please accept the calendar invite for 2028-09-15 09:00 PT and we'll run the staging smoke.

Appreciate the quick coordination — we'll treat this as a priority for current renewals in the pipeline.

Thanks,
Vanessa Ortiz
Director, Partnerships — Redwood Inference
